name: PivotAxis
description: The PivotAxis object is used for asymmetric drilling in a PivotTable.
remarks: The PivotAxis object contains properties that work with the rows and columns in the PivotTable.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified PivotAxis object. Read-only.

properties.name: PivotLines
properties.description: Returns the PivotLines object attached to the specified PivotAxis object. Read-only.
